title.english: The Parts He Had Not Made

pairs.target: yuē hǎo de nàtiān xiàwǔ , mǐlā bǐ tǎ wéi xiān dào le gōngfáng .
pairs.english: On the appointed afternoon, Mira reached the workshop before Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 约好的那天下午，米拉比塔维先到了工房。

pairs.target: tā bǎ sāngè mùkuài bǎizài zhuōshàng , quē de nàge wèizhì kōng zhe .
pairs.english: She laid the three wooden blocks on the table, leaving the missing one's place empty.
pairs.hanzi: 她把三个木块摆在桌上，缺的那个位置空着。

pairs.target: sū yǐ kào zài chuāng biān , méiyǒu tì tā shuōhuà , zhī dìgěi tā yìbǎ yǐzi .
pairs.english: Suyi leaned by the window without speaking for her, only passing her a chair.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡靠在窗边，没有替她说话，只递给她一把椅子。

pairs.target: tèlún dàilái yíkuài xīn mùliào , gēxià shíshuō hòudù hái méi páo zhǔn . mǐlā méiyǒu jiē .
pairs.english: Teren brought a fresh piece of wood and said as he put it down that it was not yet planed to the right thickness. Mira did not take it.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦带来一块新木料，搁下时说厚度还没刨准。米拉没有接。

pairs.target: kàn wū de gōngrén zhàn zài ménkǒu , wéiqún shàng zhān zhe lúhuī .
pairs.english: The caretaker stood in the doorway with furnace ash on his apron.
pairs.hanzi: 看屋的工人站在门口，围裙上沾着炉灰。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ nàtiān zhèngzài bān méi , tīngjiàn wèn shèngxià de dōngxī néng bunéng yòng , jiù dá le búyào de kěyǐ .
pairs.english: He said he had been moving coal that day and, hearing someone ask whether the leftover things could be used, had answered that unwanted things could.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己那天正在搬煤，听见问剩下的东西能不能用，就答了不要的可以。

pairs.target: tā méi kànjiàn tèlún zhǐ nǎlǐ , yě bù zhīdào jiàshàng de qiáo yào chāi .
pairs.english: He had not seen where Teren was pointing and had not known that the bridge on the shelf would be taken apart.
pairs.hanzi: 他没看见特伦指哪里，也不知道架上的桥要拆。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐwéi zhǎn guò jiù shōudiào le . " tèlún shuō .
pairs.english: “I thought it was being cleared away after the exhibition,” Teren said.
pairs.hanzi: “我以为展过就收掉了。”特伦说。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu jiàndào míngzì . tā shuō jiàndào le .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether he had seen the name. He said he had.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他有没有见到名字。他说见到了。

pairs.target: tā yòu wèn jiù zhǎnpǐn fàngzài nǎlǐ cái suàn búyào , tèlún kàn le yìyǎn kàoqiáng de fèiliào xiāng , méi zàishuō .
pairs.english: She then asked where old exhibits had to be placed to count as unwanted. Teren glanced at the scrap bin against the wall and said no more.
pairs.hanzi: 她又问旧展品放在哪里才算不要，特伦看了一眼靠墙的废料箱，没再说。

pairs.target: gōngrén cuō zhe wéiqún , shuō yǐhòu huì bǎ huà shuō quán . wéi lǎoshī qǐng tā liúxià , yìqǐ tīng mǐlā yào shénme .
pairs.english: The worker rubbed his apron and said he would be clearer in future. Instructor Vey asked him to stay and hear what Mira wanted with the others.
pairs.hanzi: 工人搓着围裙，说以后会把话说全。维老师请他留下，一起听米拉要什么。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ zuìxiǎo de mùkuài zhuǎn le yímiàn , zhǐjiǎ tíng zài yuánxiān bèi liáng yāzhù de qiǎn yìn shàng .
pairs.english: Mira turned the smallest wooden block over, her fingernail resting at the shallow mark where the beam had pressed.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把最小的木块转了一面，指甲停在原先被梁压住的浅印上。

pairs.target: " wǒ yào tā hái néng xiàng yuánlái nàyàng yòng . búshì bǎ tiě cáo xièxiàlái , shèngxià de ràng wǒ zìjǐ xiǎng bànfǎ . "
pairs.english: “I want it to work the way it did before. Not just the iron channel removed and the rest left for me to figure out.”
pairs.hanzi: “我要它还能像原来那样用。不是把铁槽卸下来，剩下的让我自己想办法。”

pairs.target: tèlún shuō néng zuòdào . mǐlā wèn bèi jù duǎn de liáng zěnmebàn . tā shuō lìng zuò yìgēn .
pairs.english: Teren said that could be done. Mira asked what would happen to the beam that had been sawn short. He said he would make another.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦说能做到。米拉问被锯短的梁怎么办。他说另做一根。

pairs.target: wèn dào dìsìgè mùkuài , tā zhǐ le zhǐ dàilái de mùliào .
pairs.english: Asked about the fourth wooden block, he pointed to the wood he had brought.
pairs.hanzi: 问到第四个木块，他指了指带来的木料。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā mōlemō mùwén , shuō bié zhào shèngxià de suíbiàn chāo , shǎo de nàge bǐ zhè sāngè báo .
pairs.english: This time she felt the grain and said not to copy the remaining ones carelessly: the missing one was thinner than these three.
pairs.hanzi: 这回她摸了摸木纹，说别照剩下的随便抄，少的那个比这三个薄。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu nà gǔ biē le jǐtiān de qì sōng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The tightness that had sat in Tavi's chest for days eased a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维胸口那股憋了几天的气松了一点。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi jiēxiàlái jiùshì chāi , tèlún què cóng yīdài lǐ qǔchū liǎngzhāng tú , fàngzài zhuōzi kōng chù .
pairs.english: He thought dismantling would come next, but Teren took two drawings from his pocket and laid them on an empty part of the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为接下来就是拆，特伦却从衣袋里取出两张图，放在桌子空处。

pairs.target: dēngjià de dǐzuò kěyǐ yán tiě cáo yídòng , shù gān shàng de huálún bǎ tí dēngshéng yǐn dào dī chù , búbì cǎi yǐzi huàndēng .
pairs.english: The lamp stand's base could move along the iron channel, and a pulley on its upright brought the lifting cord down low, so nobody needed to stand on a chair to change a lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 灯架的底座可以沿铁槽移动，竖杆上的滑轮把提灯绳引到低处，不必踩椅子换灯。

pairs.target: liǎngwèi tóngbàn zuò de guàgōu hé lúnzǐ yǐjīng zhuāng hǎo ,
pairs.english: The hooks and wheels made by his two partners were already fitted.
pairs.hanzi: 两位同伴做的挂钩和轮子已经装好，

pairs.target: cáokǒu xiàmiàn yòu tiān le yípiàn xiǎo tiě huáng , yònglái zhǐshì dǐzuò shòulì shìfǒu piānxiàng yìbiān .
pairs.english: A small iron spring had also been added beneath the channel opening to indicate whether the load on the base leaned to one side.
pairs.hanzi: 槽口下面又添了一片小铁簧，用来指示底座受力是否偏向一边。

pairs.target: tèlún zhǐ gěi wéi lǎoshī kàn , yuè shuō yuè kuài , zuìhòu shuō tāmen búshì bǎ yízuò xiǎoqiáo huàn gè míngzì .
pairs.english: Teren pointed these out to Instructor Vey, speaking faster and faster, and finally said they had not simply given a little bridge a different name.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦指给维老师看，越说越快，最后说他们不是把一座小桥换个名字。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " mǐlā shuō . tā tíngxiàlái , xiàng méi liàodào zhè jù .
pairs.english: “I know,” Mira said. He stopped, as though he had not expected that.
pairs.hanzi:
“我知道。”米拉说。
他停下来，像没料到这句。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ wǒ bùgāi bèi xiěchéng zuò le zhěnggè dēngjià de rén . " tā bǎ tú tuīhuí yíbàn ,
pairs.english: “Which is why I shouldn't be named as the person who made the whole lamp stand.” She pushed the drawings halfway back.
pairs.hanzi: “所以我不该被写成做了整个灯架的人。”她把图推回一半，

pairs.target: " wǒ méi shì guò nǐmen de dōngxī . kě nàgēn liáng , nàtiáo cáo , háiyǒu yuánlái de huázuò , shì wǒ xiān zuò de . "
pairs.english: “I haven't tested your work. But that beam, that channel, and the original sliding carriage were made by me first.”
pairs.hanzi: “我没试过你们的东西。可那根梁、那条槽，还有原来的滑座，是我先做的。”

pairs.target: sū yǐ zài chuāng biān shuō , zuówǎn tā jiàn guò de xīn páizi réng zhī xiě zhe gòngtóng zhìzuò .
pairs.english: By the window, Suyi said the new sign she had seen last night still said only “jointly made.”
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡在窗边说，昨晚她见过的新牌子仍只写着共同制作。

pairs.target: tèlún shuō kěyǐ gǎi , bǐ jiù zài zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Teren said it could be changed; the pen was right on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦说可以改，笔就在桌上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō gǎi le yě bùnéng dāng méi fāshēng , què kànjiàn mǐlā yǐjīng shēnshǒu nábǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to say that changing it could not make the incident unhappen, but saw that Mira was already reaching for the pen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说改了也不能当没发生，却看见米拉已经伸手拿笔。

pairs.target: tā xiěxià móxíng de míngzì , zài xiě jièyòng de sānjiàn dōngxī .
pairs.english: She wrote the model's name, then the three items being borrowed.
pairs.hanzi: 她写下模型的名字，再写借用的三件东西。

pairs.target: xiě dào míngtiān zhǎnshì yǐhòu guīhuán shí , tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù wèn : " nǐ hái ràng tāmen yòng ? "
pairs.english: When she reached “return after tomorrow's display,” Tavi could not help asking, “You're still letting them use it?”
pairs.hanzi: 写到明天展示以后归还时，塔维忍不住问：“你还让他们用？”

pairs.target: mǐlā tái yǎnkàn tā , méiyǒu lìkè huídá . wūlǐ de rén dōu děng zhe ,
pairs.english: Mira looked up at him without answering at once. Everyone in the room waited.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬眼看他，没有立刻回答。屋里的人都等着，

pairs.target: tā bǎ bǐ fàngxià , xiān wèn tèlún , chāihuíqù yào duōjiǔ . " hòutiān bàngwǎn qián . "
pairs.english: She put down the pen and first asked Teren how long it would take to take it apart and restore it. “Before evening the day after tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi:
她把笔放下，先问特伦，拆回去要多久。
“后天傍晚前。”

alignment.english: take it apart and restore it

pairs.target: tā shuō nà jiù xiěxià . míngtiān kěyǐ jiè zhè sānjiàn , bùnéng zài zuānkǒng ,
pairs.english: She said to write that down, then. Those three items could be borrowed tomorrow, but no more holes could be drilled.
pairs.hanzi: 她说那就写下。明天可以借这三件，不能再钻孔，

pairs.target: yě bùnéng bǎ tā de míngzì guà zài dēngjià shèjì xiàmiàn ; xiūfù hǎo de móxíng yào yóu tā zìjǐ shì guò .
pairs.english: Nor could her name be placed under the lamp stand's design; she would have to test the restored model herself.
pairs.hanzi: 也不能把她的名字挂在灯架设计下面；修复好的模型要由她自己试过。

pairs.target: tèlún dītóu dúwán , zài zhǐ shàng qiān le míngzì .
pairs.english: Teren read it with his head lowered, then signed his name on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦低头读完，在纸上签了名字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎnghòu nuó le bànbù . sū yǐ de yǐ tuǐ dǎng zài hòumiàn , tā chàdiǎn zuò dào tā xī shàng , lángbèi dì fúzhù zhuōbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped half a pace back. Suyi's chair leg was in the way behind him; he almost sat in her lap and awkwardly caught the table edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往后挪了半步。苏苡的椅腿挡在后面，他差点坐到她膝上，狼狈地扶住桌边。

pairs.target: mǐlā zuǐjiǎo dòng le yíxià , zhōngyú bú xiàng zhěng xiàwǔ dōu yǎo zhe yìkǒu yìng dōngxī .
pairs.english: Mira's mouth twitched; at last she no longer looked as if she had been biting on something hard all afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉嘴角动了一下，终于不像整下午都咬着一口硬东西。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ zhǎnshì de shì lìng tíchū lái . zhǔnxǔ jièyòng bù děngyú zhǔnxǔ zàihè , tā yào chóngxīn kàn zhuāngpèi .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey raised the display as a separate matter. Permission to borrow was not permission to apply a load; she wanted to inspect the assembly again.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把展示的事另提出来。准许借用不等于准许载荷，她要重新看装配。

pairs.target: míngtiān dēng bù diǎn , zhī guà zhuāng shā de xiǎodài , dǐxià liú jiēpán ;
pairs.english: Tomorrow the lamp would not be lit; only little bags of sand would be hung, with a catch tray underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 明天灯不点，只挂装砂的小袋，底下留接盘；

pairs.target: cānguān de rén gé zhe zhuō yán kàn , cāozuò yóu xuéshēng zuò .
pairs.english: Visitors would watch from across the table edge, and students would operate it.
pairs.hanzi: 参观的人隔着桌沿看，操作由学生做。

pairs.target: tèlún bǎ lúnzǐ zhuǎngěi tā kàn . mǐlā yě kàojìn , zhǐchū shéngzi kàobiān shíhuì cā dào mùtou .
pairs.english: Teren turned the wheel for her. Mira came closer too and pointed out that the cord rubbed the wood when it moved to the side.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦把轮子转给她看。米拉也靠近，指出绳子靠边时会擦到木头。

pairs.target: nà shì gāngcái méishuōde dìfāng . tèlún xiān zhòuméi , shì le yícì , ná cuòdāo qù xiū biān , méi zài zhēng .
pairs.english: That was something not mentioned earlier. Teren frowned at first, tried it once, and fetched a file to smooth the edge without arguing again.
pairs.hanzi: 那是刚才没说的地方。特伦先皱眉，试了一次，拿锉刀去修边，没再争。

pairs.target: děng tāmen shōushí hǎo , gōngfáng yǐjīng yǒu le wǎnfàn de qìwèi .
pairs.english: By the time they had tidied up, the smell of supper had reached the workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 等他们收拾好，工房已经有了晚饭的气味。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé luò héng bèijiào qù bǎi lìng yìzhuō de liángjù .
pairs.english: Tavi and Lohen were called over to lay out measuring instruments on another table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和洛衡被叫去摆另一桌的量具。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī yǔnxǔ tāmen míngtiān zuò shúxī de jiēchù shìfàn , zhīyòng pèi hǎo de xiǎo tiěpiàn , bú zuò lí shǒu liú xiào .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey allowed them to give the familiar contact demonstration tomorrow, using only the paired small iron strips, with no hands-free residual effect.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师允许他们明天做熟悉的接触示范，只用配好的小铁片，不做离手留效。

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ yípiàn bù cānyù shìfàn de tiě huáng jiá zài dúlì mù zuò shàng ,
pairs.english: Lohen clamped an iron spring not involved in the demonstration to a separate wooden stand.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把一片不参与示范的铁簧夹在独立木座上，

pairs.target: mòduān guà zhe tóng zhòng de xiǎo fǎmǎ , pángbiān lì yìzhāng kèxiàn zhǐ .
pairs.english: A little weight of the same mass hung at its tip, and a sheet of marked paper stood beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 末端挂着同重的小砝码，旁边立一张刻线纸。

pairs.target: zhèyàng láikè kěyǐ bǐjiào méi bèi jiè xìng de wānqū .
pairs.english: This let visitors compare bending that had not been altered by property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 这样来客可以比较没被借性的弯曲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fúzhèng zhǐbǎn , wèn tā shìbushì yě dé xiě míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi straightened the card and asked whether this needed a name as well.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维扶正纸板，问它是不是也得写名字。

pairs.target: " xiě yòngtú . " luò héng shuō , guò le yíhuìer yòu bǔ yíjù , " mù zuò shì wǒ de . "
pairs.english: “Write what it's for,” Lohen said, then after a while added, “The wooden stand is mine.”
pairs.hanzi: “写用途。”洛衡说，过了一会儿又补一句，“木座是我的。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào chū le shēng . tā zhàoshí xiě shàng , mòjì méi gān , biàn bǎshǒu suōhuílái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed aloud. He wrote that down faithfully and pulled his hand back before the ink had dried.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑出了声。他照实写上，墨迹没干，便把手缩回来。

pairs.target: duìmiàn de tèlún hái zài cuò nà dào mù biān , mǐlā zhàn zài yìpáng děng zhe shì , shuí dōu méi cuī tā zǒu .
pairs.english: Across from them Teren was still filing the wooden edge, while Mira stood waiting to try it. Nobody urged her to leave.
pairs.hanzi: 对面的特伦还在锉那道木边，米拉站在一旁等着试，谁都没催她走。
